# std/sub

> - : subtraction

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/sub.pkg) · translated by [bintables/sub](../bintables/sub.md) · translated by [ctables/sub](../ctables/sub.md) · translated by [webtables/sub](../webtables/sub.md)

Subtraction. Overflow wraps around (two's complement).

```
print 10 - 2 - 3   // 5 (left-associative)
```

Infix, precedence 50, left-associative. Both operands must be `int`; the
result is `int`.
